Can someone please provide guidance as to how I can squash the commits, so this will be ready to be merged?

You can use `git rebase -i @~11`. Rebase -i lets you interactively change your local history, "@" is shorthand for HEAD, and "~11" means "rebase over the last 11 commits", which is one more than you're working with. 10 would work as well, but I tend to add one more just so I know where I am in the commit history.

Running it will switch to an editor listing the last 11 commits with options on what to do. You'll want to "squash" the first nine, which will meld them into the 10th commit. After that you should be presented with the option of editing your commit message.

I don't claim to be a git expert, but I was able to clean it up by doing the following:

- Run `git rebase -i @~1 --rebase-merges`. In this case "rebase-merges" avoids a merge conflict.

- In the rebase commit message, squash commits ce5de92fe7 to d8bee845ff:
```
label onto

# Branch patch-6
reset a750cab655 # thread: Add check for valid CoAP info
pick da7f9456d4 Add docbook job
s ce5de92fe7 Only run when docbook is modified
s fbc3b4fff7 Changes in all subdirs
s a98c176083 extra doublequote
s 1ff6896c53 Also build if wslua is modified
s 6e7c72057e Update .gitlab-ci.yml
s e91754ca4a Use wireshark/wireshark-ubuntu-dev and remove PDF docs to lower build time by 50%
s 2933ebb719 gitlab-ci: Add docbook job for WSUG and WSDG
s a6fdc8d193 Switch to using rules syntax
s d8bee845ff Update .gitlab-ci.yml
label patch-6

reset onto
merge -C 7183898fa2 patch-6 # Merge branch 'patch-6' of gitlab.com:moshekaplan/wireshark into patch-6
```

- Get rid of the merge request by running `git pull --rebase <upstream> master`. "upstream" should be the remote that points to "git@gitlab.com:wireshark/wireshark.git"

@@ -148,6 +148,34 @@ test:debian-stable:
   dependencies:
     - build:debian-stable
 
+# Build Wireshark manuals
+# Note: Need ubuntu:focal with `ruby-coderay` and `ruby-asciidoctor-pdf` packages to build PDF docs
+docbook:
+  stage: build
+  image: wireshark/wireshark-ubuntu-dev
+  rules:
+    - changes:
+      - "docbook/**"
+      - "epan/wslua/**"
+  before_script:
+    - DEBIAN_FRONTEND="noninteractive" ./tools/debian-setup.sh --install-optional -y g++
+  script:
+    - mkdir build
+    - cd build
+    - cmake -GNinja ..
+    - ninja all_guides
+  after_script:
+    - mv build/docbook/wsug_html/ .
+    - mv build/docbook/wsug_html_chunked/ .
+    - mv build/docbook/wsdg_html/ .
+    - mv build/docbook/wsdg_html_chunked/ .
+  artifacts:
+    paths:
+      - wsug_html/
+      - wsug_html_chunked/
+      - wsdg_html/
+      - wsdg_html_chunked/
+

commits_data.message:
gitlab-ci: Add docbook job for WSUG and WSDG

Adds job of building the HTML versions of the
Wireshark User Guide and Wireshark Developer Guide.
PDF versions are not built because it would take significantly longer
(~10 mins instead of ~5 minutes)
